headline: ETF Demand Supports Majors as Altcoin Rotation Stalls
summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum held key support while selective capital rotated out of high-beta altcoins.

movers.name: Bitcoin
movers.catalyst: Steady ETF net inflows and resilient spot demand.

movers.name: Ethereum
movers.catalyst: Large-cap rotation and stable staking participation.

movers.name: Avalanche
movers.catalyst: Momentum unwind after a sharp prior-week rally.

sections.heading: Market Overview
sections.body: Liquidity stayed concentrated in majors while altcoin breadth softened.
highlights: BTC closed above its weekly VWAP.
Perpetual funding reset to neutral across major venues.

sections.heading: Positioning & Flows
sections.body: Institutional participation remained constructive, but speculative leverage cooled.
highlights: Spot ETF flow momentum remained positive for a sixth consecutive week.
Open interest declined in mid-cap perpetual pairs.

thesis: Major-asset demand remains the primary support while broad altcoin participation fades.
ETF-related flows are still cushioning pullbacks, but upside follow-through is slowing.
Positioning is shifting from high-beta momentum into higher-liquidity names.
riskChecklist: Watch for a break below prior weekly support in BTC before adding directional risk.
Monitor ETF net-flow momentum for a second consecutive down week.
Track funding and open interest for signs of leverage re-expansion.
Confirm stablecoin supply growth continues to support spot liquidity.
Respect macro event windows that can override crypto-native flow signals.

watchlistLevels.context: Holding support keeps the range constructive; reclaiming resistance reopens trend continuation.
Sustained closes above pivot improve odds of renewed ETH-led breadth.
A fresh low would confirm ongoing altcoin-relative weakness.
